title: Impaired Driver Brutally Rear Ends State Trooper During Traffic Stop
description:
On March 31, 2021, a deputy conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle which resulted in an OWI arrest in Racine, WI. The driver happened to have two children under the age of two so they were moved into a squad car temporarily. While a family member was on their way to take custody of them, a Wisconsin State Trooper assisted the traffic stop by blocking a lane of traffic. Moments later, the State Trooper was rear-ended by another impaired driver.
